== Summary ==
Decipher, Inc. corporate logo lockup dated 1999: brushstroke circular mark, DECIPHER wordmark, tagline "The Art of Great Games".

'''Source:''' [https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/File:decipher_old_logo.jpg File:decipher old logo.jpg] on the LOTR-TCG wiki (used on [https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Decipher Decipher] with caption "It's an older logo, sir, but it checks out."). Downstream copy for wiki.swccg.com encyclopedia use.

'''Era:''' Late 1990s CCG peak (packaging / print © line 1999).
